title: Chiefs: 'Top-5 guy' in CB Delane worth trade up

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Chiefs: 'Top-5 guy' in CB Delane worth trade up
sources.description: The Chiefs moved up in the NFL draft, acquiring the No. 6 pick from the Browns and using it to select LSU cornerback Mansoor Delane. Cleveland took Spencer Fano at No. 9.
